summary: Request for native SPIFFE support in Temporal Server to enable automatic certificate lifecycle management, identity-based authorization, and simplified deployments using SPIFFE IDs instead of manual TLS/mTLS configuration.
userImpact: Enables enterprises to deploy Temporal with zero-trust security patterns using SPIFFE/SPIRE infrastructure without manual certificate rotation or external tooling.
rootCause: Current Temporal TLS/mTLS implementation requires manual certificate management or external tooling integration; SPIFFE identity information in certificates is extracted but unused for authorization.
proposedFix: Integrate SPIFFE Workload API with GetCertificate callbacks, implement SPIFFE-based ClaimMapper for authorization, support claim mapper chains for migration, extend TLS config structs with SPIFFE options.
workaround: Users can manually manage certificates or integrate cert-manager/spiffe-helper as external tooling, but this adds operational complexity.
keyQuote: Native SPIFFE support integrated directly into Temporal server with automatic certificate lifecycle management and identity-based authorization using SPIFFE IDs.
